mainEntity.name: How do I test whether my AI landing page is actually better than my old one?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Use AI to create a first version, then test the page with a defined audience and measurable goal. Do not change headlines, pricing, design, and offer at the same time because you will not know which change affected the result.

Context: Run My AI Business describes landing-page analysis and conversion-focused improvements as support for testing and prioritization. A test needs enough relevant traffic and a stable comparison to be informative.

Key factors:
- Primary conversion event
- Traffic source and audience consistency
- Sample size and test duration
- Quality of leads, not only quantity

Practical guidance: Record the original version and choose one high-priority hypothesis, such as clearer audience wording or a shorter form. Review results alongside customer quality and follow-up behavior.

The business can help draft variants and organize the review process without claiming a guaranteed winner.
acceptedAnswer.description: Define one conversion goal, record the original page, and test one meaningful change at a time. Keep the audience and traffic source comparable, then review both conversion rate and lead quality. AI can propose variants, but your measurement plan determines what the test means.
